operation: Generate lock-derived CycloneDX SBOM with the temporary exact-lock Python 3.14.0 interpreter
cause: pip-audit created a transient resolver environment whose ensurepip process terminated with SIGABRT
affected_evidence: No SBOM was produced by this attempt
recovery: The identical lock-derived requirements input was audited with the verified project Python 3.14.7 interpreter; no known vulnerabilities were found and the final 79-component CycloneDX SBOM was retained.
